what: Strength rows (title, description, image) stick 110px from the top of the screen, and each next row sticks 100px lower (210·310·410px) and rises to cover the previous row’s image. Only the earlier titles remain, stepped like a stacked table of contents, and since the row height shrinks by 110px each time, they all release together at nearly one spot.

options.top: Where the first line attaches (px or unit), default 110px — 55rem on phone
options.step: Step down per row (px or unit), default 100px — phone is 60rem
options.height: First row height, default 1010px — on phone calc(100vh - 55rem)
options.shrink: Height shrunk per row, default 110px — 60rem on phone
options.[data-fx-part=item]: Rows that stack on one another (direct children, two or more). Fill the background so the row behind does not show through (default --kf-bg)
options.fill: Row background, default --kf-bg — none means no fill (a title-only contents list needs the back to show through · corp-brand)
options.look: With 「center」, the line sticks centered on screen (top default 50vh, step default 0) and the next line covers it in the same place — height follows the content · center photo of a corporate original site
